public_builder_identity.semantic_mapping: Occ_table identificationRemarks is copied directly from BALA_all_data$MF
public_builder_identity.routing_token_interpretation: identificationRemarks is the stable BALA morphospecies/species reference token MF

event_core_link.role: core eventID reference; forbidden to read during opaque taxon routing

organismQuantity.role: pilot/confirmatory response quantity; forbidden during opaque taxon routing

eventID.role: event identity; forbidden during opaque taxon routing

identificationRemarks.role: MF taxon routing token; the only Occurrence data field authorized during opaque partition routing

scientificName.role: taxon label; forbidden during opaque partition routing

order.role: later taxonomic eligibility audit; forbidden during opaque partition routing

family.role: later taxonomic eligibility audit; forbidden during opaque partition routing

taxonRank.role: later taxonomic eligibility audit; forbidden during opaque partition routing

taxon_token_normalization.whitespace: strip leading and trailing ASCII/Unicode whitespace
taxon_token_normalization.blank_token: STOP row routing and do not assign the row

deterministic_partition.hash_input: salt + normalized MF token encoded UTF-8
deterministic_partition.bucket_rule: unsigned integer from the first 8 hexadecimal SHA-256 digits modulo 4

opaque_router_semantics_for_next_gate.all_other_occurrence_fields: opaque bytes copied unchanged with the row to its assigned partition

future_stage_order: v1.135 schema/partition rule only; zero Occurrence data rows decoded
opaque row routing reads MF token only and writes disjoint pilot versus confirmatory byte surfaces
pilot taxon rows may then open eventID, quantity and taxonomic fields for estimability/eligibility only; no source-leverage effect estimate
after a clean pilot gate, freeze t0/t1 confirmatory exposure/source-leverage features and all t2 predictions before any confirmatory t2 response is opened
anti_selection: do not choose a different partition salt or pilot fraction after taxon counts are known
do not inspect eventID, quantity, scientificName or taxonomic fields while routing confirmatory rows
do not select pilot taxa by prevalence, trend or source-loss behaviour
do not use confirmatory token identities to refine taxonomic scope
do not change the pitfall surveyed-zero quality thresholds after pilot occurrence access
